newsitem.title: ITALY: Action needed to change Italy banking system - Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Action needed to change Italy banking system - Fazio.

text.p: The Italian banking system is wasteful and in urgent need of modernisation, Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said on Thursday.
"Costs in our banking system are very high," Fazio said in a speech to mark the world day of savings. "Costs must be significantly cut, especially personnel costs," he added.

"It is urgent that (across) the system decisive action is launched," he said, warning that in the face of growing international competition, Italy's banking sector could not stand still. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
